value.rationale: The standard Until connective is the canonical first benchmark for temporal explanation enumeration. Determining every subset-minimal explanation and both conditional joint laws exposes a precise one-CXp polarity shift, identical AXp marginals, and computable covariance. This is an all-length structural distribution theorem useful as an exact comparison point for explanation enumeration, not a small case enumeration or a renaming of general hitting-set duality.
